title: Episode About Udasi to the North

blocks.text: The northern udasi carries Guru Nanak into the mountainous northern regions, lands imagined as filled with siddhas, ascetics, devas, and sacred heights where truth and falsehood had to be weighed carefully. (1–2)

The poet pauses to admit that these journeys are too numerous to narrate in full, since many details already live in janam-sakhi traditions and a complete retelling would swell the book beyond measure. (3, 8–10)

Even so, he stresses one constant: wherever Guru Nanak went in those northern regions, he challenged empty ritual and stone worship, and established the remembrance of the true Name through clear teaching. (4–7)
